lines.en: label bar30:
scene sanadrunkagain1
: Hey...*hic* you...
: Whatchadoin’here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干哈呢？

lines.en: I arrive at the bar to find an unexpectedly inebriated Sana.
lines.zh: 我到了酒吧，没想到 Sana 已经醉成这样了。

lines.en: Typically, things like drinking in your own workplace are frowned upon, especially for a [high_school]er...
lines.zh: 一般来说，在自己上班的地方喝酒是不太合适的，尤其是对一个 [high_school]生来说……

lines.en: But I guess given the nature of this establishment, it’s not too unusual.
lines.zh: 不过考虑到这地方的性质，好像也不算太稀奇。

lines.en: I’m sure her mother was doing the exact same thing at her age.
lines.zh: 她妈妈在她这个年纪，肯定也干过一模一样的事。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain2
: Sensei! How dare you get my daughter drunk while I wasn’t watching!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你竟敢趁我不注意把我女儿灌醉！

lines.en: : Wait, what? I literally just got here.
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？我这才刚进门啊。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain3
: I know that, silly. I’m just messing with you.
lines.zh: : 我知道啦，傻瓜。逗你玩儿的。

lines.en: : We closed early tonight because Sana wasn’t feeling great.
lines.zh: : 今晚提前打烊了，因为 Sana 不太舒服。

lines.en: : Sooooo I gave her the only medicine that’s ever worked for me.
lines.zh: : 所以嘛——我就给她用了对我来说唯一管用的那种药。

lines.en: : You medicated your daughter with alcohol?
lines.zh: : 你用酒精给你女儿治病？

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain2
: Well it worked, didn’t it? Look at her! She’s just peachy!
lines.zh: : 可这不是管用嘛，你看看她！精神着呢！

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain4
: Hey...ya ever think’ that...there’s more to life than just...all the things you do in life?
lines.zh: : 嘿……你有没有想过……人生除了……人生里做的那些事之外，还有点别的？

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 这话到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : Itmeanseverything.
lines.zh: : 意思就是一切。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain3
: Are you positive that all she’s had is alcohol? She seems a little too far gone for that to be true.
lines.zh: : 你确定她只喝了酒？她这副样子，光靠酒可到不了这个程度。

lines.en: : She just needs to build up her tolerance. She might be my daughter but it’s not like she was born with an iron stomach.
lines.zh: : 她就是得多练练酒量。虽说是我女儿，可她也不是天生一副铁胃。

lines.en: : Is it even your stomach that processes alcohol?
lines.zh: : 处理酒精的到底是胃吗？

lines.en: : Beats me. You’re the teacher here.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。这儿的老师是你啊。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain4
: Sensei...I’vebeendoin’somethinking...
lines.zh: : Sensei……我一直在思考人生……

lines.en: : And I think...it’s about time I...cameouttamyshell...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……是时候……走出我的壳了……

lines.en: : *Hic* ya know? Sometimes ya just gotta get out there and do the thing.
lines.zh: : *嗝*你懂吧？人有时候就是得出去，把那件事给做了。

lines.en: : What “thing” are you trying to do exactly, Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana，你到底想做的是哪件“事”？

lines.en: : Idunno...issa...thing Rin says all the time...
lines.zh: : 我不道……就是……Rin 老挂在嘴边的那件事……

lines.en: : I’m just...doing what the Romans do...
lines.zh: : 我不过是……入乡随俗……

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain2
: And on that note, I’m going to head upstairs.
lines.zh: : 说到这儿，我就上楼去了。

lines.en: : Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？

lines.en: : I was under the impression you’d be joining us.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你会一起呢。

lines.en: : Not tonight, I’m afraid. There’s a glass of wine and a romance novel waiting for me in my bedroom.
lines.zh: : 今晚恐怕不行。我卧室里还有一杯葡萄酒和一本言情小说等着我呢。

lines.en: : Why is there already a glass of wine poured in your bedroom?
lines.zh: : 你卧室里怎么已经倒好一杯葡萄酒了？

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain5
: Stop asking questions and comfort my daughter.
lines.zh: : 别问了，去安慰我女儿。

lines.en: : She’s been down all day and I think you’re the one she needs to see.
lines.zh: : 她一整天都闷闷不乐的，我觉得她现在需要见的人是你。

lines.en: : I love her, but I’m not exactly the best when it comes to cheering people up. Hence alcohol.
lines.zh: : 我爱她，但说到哄人开心，我确实不太在行。所以才用酒精。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain4
: Yeah...*hic* stay and...talk to me...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 就是嘛……*嗝*留下来……陪我说说话……Sensei……

lines.en: : We’ll be all alone...we can do...{i}whateverwewant{/i}...
lines.zh: : 就我们两个……我们可以做……{i}任何我们想做的事{/i}……

lines.en: : Remember Sensei, even if girls say that while they’re drunk, they don’t necessarily mean it.
lines.zh: : Sensei 你记住，女孩子喝醉的时候说这种话，不一定是真心的。

lines.en: : You’re one to talk, Sara.
lines.zh: : 这话从你嘴里说出来，Sara。

lines.en: : Heheh~ I sure am.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~我当然是。

lines.en: : Have a good night, you two!
lines.zh: : 祝你们俩今晚愉快！

lines.en: I can hear Sara’s footsteps trail up the stairs and stop in the room above us.
lines.zh: 我听见 Sara 的脚步声一路上了楼，停在我们头顶那间屋子里。

lines.en: I can even hear the bed squeak as she hops onto it.
lines.zh: 她往床上一跳，连床咯吱响的声音都听得见。

lines.en: That’s...mildly concerning for a number of reasons.
lines.zh: 这……出于好几重原因，多少让人有点在意。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain1
: Hehehe...now I’ve gotcha...alltomyself...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……现在你……归我一个人了……

lines.en: : How much have you had to drink, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你到底喝了多少？

lines.en: : A million...
lines.zh: : 一百万……

lines.en: : I think we need to get you into an ambulance if that’s the case.
lines.zh: : 那这样的话，我觉得得叫救护车了。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain6
: I’m just kidding...I’m drunk but not...a million drunk.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的啦……我是醉了，但没……醉到一百万那么醉。

lines.en: : Wow, you really had me going there for a second. I sincerely believed you were a million drunk.
lines.zh: : 哇，那一瞬间我还真被你唬住了。我是真心以为你醉了一百万。

lines.en: : Heheh~ It’s all that...role playing experience from...vacation.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~这全靠……假期里那点……角色扮演的经验。

lines.en: : Well, whatever you do, please don’t cut me in half like that mushroom monster or whatever it was.
lines.zh: : 行吧，不管你想干什么，都别像那只蘑菇怪什么的那样把我劈成两半。

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry...Orc Sana is much stronger than normal Sana...
lines.zh: : 你不用担心……兽人 Sana 比普通 Sana 强多了……

lines.en: : Normal Sana probably couldn’t even hold a battle axe...
lines.zh: : 普通 Sana 大概连战斧都举不起来……

lines.en: Sana sprawls out further so her leg doesn’t wind up falling off of the table.
lines.zh: Sana 又往开张了张，免得腿从桌上滑下去。

lines.en: She looks very different from how she normally is. And no, it's not because she’s drunk.
lines.zh: 她看上去跟平时很不一样。不，不是因为她喝醉了。

lines.en: Well, I'm sure that's part of it.
lines.zh: 好吧，我承认这也是一部分原因。

lines.en: But it’s the first time I’ve seen her in an actual relaxed position.
lines.zh: 但这还是我第一次看到她真正放松下来的样子。

lines.en: It’s like she’s lounging around her bedroom right now.
lines.zh: 就好像此刻她正窝在自己卧室里赖着。

lines.en: Which, to be fair, is at least partially true since her mother is right upstairs.
lines.zh: 话说回来，这至少有一半是真的——她妈妈就在楼上。

lines.en: But still.
lines.zh: 但也不全是。

lines.en: : Aren’t you...gonna ask me what was bothering me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你……不打算问我为什么心情不好吗？

lines.en: : My mom just told ya I was down and you haven’t even...asked me why yet...
lines.zh: : 我妈都跟你说了我不开心，可你连……问都没问过我为什么……

lines.en: : If I was Ayane, you probably would’ve asked right away...right?
lines.zh: : 如果我是 Ayane，你大概早就问了吧……对吧？

lines.en: : I was getting there.
lines.zh: : 我正要说呢。

lines.en: : You’re still not great at conversation yet, so you haven’t realized that there are some steps involved when you want to get someone to open up.
lines.zh: : 你还不太擅长聊天，所以你不知道，想让人敞开心扉是有些步骤的。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain7
: What kind of steps?...
lines.zh: : 什么步骤？……

lines.en: : Small talk. Prodding.
lines.zh: : 闲聊。试探。

lines.en: : Prodding sounds lewd...Is that really one of the steps?...
lines.zh: : 试探听起来好下流……这真的是其中一个步骤吗？……

lines.en: : Not that kind of prodding. That comes later.
lines.zh: : 不是那种试探。那种是后面的事。

lines.en: : But yeah...what’s bothering you exactly?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来……你到底在烦什么？

lines.en: : Woah...I’m glad you asked without...me having to force you to...
lines.zh: : 哇哦……你居然不用我逼……就自己问了……

lines.en: : Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain8
: Remember that girl from the other night?
lines.zh: : 还记得那天晚上那个女孩吗？

lines.en: : What, you mean the creepy, white-haired one?
lines.zh: : 是说那个一头白发、怪吓人的？

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s the one.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就是她。

lines.en: : She said some strange things, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她说了些很奇怪的话，对吧？

lines.en: : Pretty much everything she said was strange.
lines.zh: : 她说的话基本没有一句不奇怪。

lines.en: : She said you saw God...
lines.zh: : 她说你见到了上帝……

lines.en: : Is that true, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 是真的吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Not to my knowledge. I’m pretty sure I’d remember something like that.
lines.zh: : 据我所知没有。这种事我要是碰上了，肯定会记得。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain6
: Would you?
lines.zh: : 真的会吗？

lines.en: : Maybe God has like...crazy mind control powers or something...like in a movie.
lines.zh: : 说不定上帝有那种……特别厉害的精神控制能力什么的……就像电影里那样。

lines.en: : He’s God, so he can do whatever he wants, right?
lines.zh: : 他可是上帝啊，想干什么就干什么，对吧？

lines.en: : Is that why you’re feeling down? You’re thinking about God?
lines.zh: : 你心情不好就是因为一直在想上帝？

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain9
: Nah...It’s nothing that interesting...
lines.zh: : 才不是……没那么有意思……

lines.en: : It’s something else she said that’s been bugging me.
lines.zh: : 是她说的另一句话一直在我脑子里打转。

lines.en: I think back to the other things the white-haired girl said during our very brief but extraordinarily creepy meeting.
lines.zh: 我回想了一下那个白发女孩跟我们那场短暂却格外瘆人的会面里说的其他话。

lines.en: The ones that stick out among them are...something about the path I walk...seeing the end of the world and...
lines.zh: 其中最扎眼的几句分别是……关于我所走的道路……看见了世界的尽头……还有……

lines.en: That someone Sana knows is happy.
lines.zh: 还有 Sana 认识的某个人很幸福。

lines.en: : Who was the girl talking about when she looked at you?
lines.zh: : 她看着你的时候，说的是谁？

lines.en: : Could be anyone...she was...kind of weird...
lines.zh: : 可能是任何人吧……她……是有点怪……

lines.en: : But, if I had to take a guess-
lines.zh: : 不过，非要我猜的话——

lines.en: : Probably my brother.
lines.zh: : 大概是我哥哥吧。

lines.en: : You have a brother?
lines.zh: : 你有哥哥？

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain10
: You don’t pay much attention...do you?
lines.zh: : 你平时都没怎么留心……是吧？

lines.en: : I told you that the first time you came to the bar...and you never even asked about it.
lines.zh: : 你第一次来这酒吧的时候我就跟你说过了……结果你连问都没问过一句。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain6
: How long have you been coming here now?...
lines.zh: : 你都来这儿多久了？……

lines.en: : Long enough to start asking me more personal questions...right?
lines.zh: : 够久了，该开始问我点更私人的问题了吧……对吧？

lines.en: I try to think back to my first meeting with Sana at the bar, but it seems so long ago now.
lines.zh: 我试着回想第一次在酒吧见到 Sana 的情景，可那已经像是很久以前的事了。

lines.en: But somewhere, buried deep beneath almost every other memory I’ve made with her, there is {i}something{/i}.
lines.zh: 但在我和她之间几乎每一段回忆的深处，埋着 {i}某样东西{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s his uniform, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那是他的制服，对吧？

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain8
: Was...
lines.zh: : 曾经是……

lines.en: : He’s gone now.
lines.zh: : 他已经不在了。

lines.en: : Which is probably why...that crazy girl’s words went straight to my head...
lines.zh: : 大概就是因为这个……那个疯丫头的话才会一直往我脑子里钻……

lines.en: : Chances are she was just...off her medication like you said..but what if she wasn’t?
lines.zh: : 她很可能只是……像你说的那样没吃药……可万一她吃了呢？

lines.en: : What if she can...talk to the dead...or something?
lines.zh: : 万一她真的能……跟死人说话……什么的？

lines.en: : Sooo, yeah...That’s what I’ve been thinking about.
lines.zh: : 所以嘛，嗯……我一直在想的就是这个。

lines.en: : And I’m guessing that’s also why you couldn’t bring your mom into it?
lines.zh: : 我猜，这也是你没法跟你妈开口的原因？

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain11
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : It’s really hard, you know?...
lines.zh: : 真的很难，你知道吗？……

lines.en: : She changes the subject any time it comes up...
lines.zh: : 每次一提到这个，她就把话题岔开……

lines.en: : We’ve never even really talked about it before...
lines.zh: : 我们以前连一次正经地聊过都没有……

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain12
: You’d think me wearing his clothes to work every day would at least start a conversation with her but...nope.
lines.zh: : 我天天穿着他的衣服上班，按说总能让她开口聊聊了吧……结果并没有。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain13
: Who knows, though? Maybe I’m just crazy and he never existed in the first place...
lines.zh: : 不过谁知道呢？也许是我疯了，他根本就不存在过……

lines.en: : Maybe it’s all just a dream.
lines.zh: : 也许这一切只是一场梦。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain14
: Um...A-Anyway! H-How about we talk about something...fun instead?
lines.zh: : 呃……总、总之！我、我们聊点开心的吧？

lines.en: : I...don’t want to be one of those people who just...rambles on and on about her feelings when she’s drunk so...
lines.zh: : 我……不想变成那种喝醉了就……没完没了倒苦水的人，所以……

lines.en: : Maybe we could play the question game again?...
lines.zh: : 我们要不要再玩一次问答游戏？……

lines.en: : Makoto’s mom isn’t here to interrupt us this time so...we can ask whatever we want...
lines.zh: : 这次 Makoto 的妈妈不在，不会来打断我们了……想问什么都可以……

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain15
: I’d...still prefer nothing perverted, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……我还是希望别问那种下流的问题……

lines.en: : Even if we’re closer than we were before...you’re still my teacher and...there’s the thing with Ayane too and...
lines.zh: : 就算我们比从前亲近了……你也还是我的老师，而且……还有 Ayane 那档子事，还有……

lines.en: : And my mom is right upstairs.
lines.zh: : 而且我妈就在楼上。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, here’s a question...
lines.zh: : 好。那我问一个……

lines.en: : Why does everyone you associate with like me so much? It's odd.
lines.zh: : 为什么跟你沾边的人都这么喜欢我？挺怪的。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain16
: Right?!
lines.zh: : 就是说啊！

lines.en: : I have no idea!
lines.zh: : 我完全搞不懂！

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how weird that is for me?!
lines.zh: : 你知道对我来说这有多别扭吗？！

lines.en: : It’s weirder for me. I don’t even think I’ve done anything to warrant that sort of admiration.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我更怪。我压根不觉得自己做过什么配得上这种崇拜。

lines.en: : You really haven’t!
lines.zh: : 你确实没有！

lines.en: : You could have at least tried to pretend that wasn’t true.
lines.zh: : 你至少可以装个样子说不是吧。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain17
: Sorry...I’m drunk and...don’t have control over myself right now...
lines.zh: : 对不起……我喝醉了……现在管不住自己……

lines.en: : You know I think you’re cool...
lines.zh: : 你知道我觉得你很酷的……

lines.en: : I’m sure everyone else sees you the same way...
lines.zh: : 别人肯定也是这么看你的……

lines.en: : Also, umm, this might sound a little weird...but I think you have really pretty eyes as well...
lines.zh: : 还有，嗯……这话听着可能有点怪……但我觉得你的眼睛也特别好看……

lines.en: : It’s even...kind of hard to look at them sometimes.
lines.zh: : 有时候……甚至有点不敢直视。

lines.en: : Thanks Sana. I think you have a really pretty eye as well.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Sana。我觉得你的那只眼睛也特别好看。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain18
: The second one actually has special powers...
lines.zh: : 其实第二只眼睛是有特殊能力的……

lines.en: : The reason I was holding my hair back for most of this conversation was to...hypnotize you...
lines.zh: : 我刚才大半时间都在把头发往后撩，就是为了……对你催眠……

lines.en: : Into doing what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 催眠我去干什么？

lines.en: : Into being a normal teacher again. One that can help me with history...
lines.zh: : 让你重新变回一个正常的老师。一个能辅导我历史的老师……

lines.en: : And also one that doesn’t think my mom is cute.
lines.zh: : 还有，一个别觉得我妈可爱的老师。

lines.en: : Okay, come on, though. We both know your mom is cute.
lines.zh: : 哎，得了吧。你妈可爱这事咱俩心里都有数。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain19
: Ugh! Don't remind me! It's annoying!
lines.zh: : 呃啊！别提醒我！烦死了！

lines.en: : She’s pure evil, I tell you! She’d do anything to be the center of attention!
lines.zh: : 我跟你说，她就是纯粹的邪恶！为了当全场焦点她什么都干得出来！

lines.en: : I’m gonna go get another drink!
lines.zh: : 我要再去拿一杯！

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain20
: Do you want anything?!
lines.zh: : 你要不要来点什么？！

lines.en: : ...I’ll have a beer.
lines.zh: : ……来瓶啤酒吧。

lines.en: : Okay!
lines.zh: : 好嘞！

lines.en: Sana storms off toward the bar and throws open the doors of the cooler, grabbing a drink for both herself and me.
lines.zh: Sana 气冲冲地走向吧台，一把拉开冷藏柜的门，给她自己和我各拿了一瓶。

lines.en: I’m surprised she had such a...passionate reaction to my mention of Sara this time.
lines.zh: 我挺意外，这次提到 Sara，她居然有这么……激烈的反应。

lines.en: Maybe it’s just the alcohol, but I feel like she’d typically get embarrassed and down on herself instead of walking away in a fit of rage.
lines.zh: 也许只是酒精作祟，但我觉得她平时更可能是害臊、自怨自艾，而不是一怒之下走开。

lines.en: The dynamic between those two is confusing.
lines.zh: 她们母女俩之间的相处方式真是让人看不懂。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain21
Sana returns moments later with two cans- one for me and one for her.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，Sana 拿着两罐回来了——一罐给我，一罐给她自己。

lines.en: She also doesn’t say a single word and elects to just stare at me instead.
lines.zh: 她也是一个字不说，就那么盯着我。

lines.en: : ...What?
: You realize...that if I finish this beer...I may not be able to walk.
lines.zh: : 你知道的吧……我要是把这罐喝完……可能就走不动路了。

lines.en: : Then why drink it?...
lines.zh: : 那你还喝？……

lines.en: : I...do not give you permission to carry me upstairs again.
lines.zh: : 我……不批准你再把我抱上楼。

lines.en: : I am still dealing with the embarrassment from the last time that happened.
lines.zh: : 上次那事带来的羞耻感我到现在还没缓过来。

lines.en: : So...just leave you on the couch?
lines.zh: : 那……就把你扔沙发上？

lines.en: : It’s a good couch.
lines.zh: : 那沙发挺好的。

lines.en: : Sure, whatever. Just don’t look at me like that anymore. It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 行吧，随便你。别再用那种眼神看我了，怪瘆人的。

lines.en: : You’re weird.
lines.zh: : 你才怪。

lines.en: : Okay, Sana.
lines.zh: : 好好好，Sana。

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain22
: Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : I’m glad you came tonight, Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei，我很高兴你今晚能来……

lines.en: : I’m already feeling a little better...
lines.zh: : 我已经好受一点了……

lines.en: scene sanadrunkagain23
: Maybe my mom’s method of medicating...works after all?...
lines.zh: : 也许我妈那套“治病”的办法……其实真的管用？……

lines.en: : Yeah, let’s not have you fall down the path to alcoholism at such a [young]age.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我们可不能让你在这么[young]的年纪就走上酗酒这条路。

lines.en: scene black
Sana does, in fact, finish the beer.
lines.zh: Sana 果然把那罐啤酒喝完了。

lines.en: And her legs do, in fact, give out.
lines.zh: 而她的腿也果然一软。

lines.en: I walk up the stairs into Sara’s apartment to find her already passed out.
lines.zh: 我上楼走进 Sara 的公寓，发现她已经昏睡过去了。

lines.en: So much for her romance novel, I guess.
lines.zh: 看来那本言情小说是看不成了。

lines.en: I take a spare pillow and blanket from a couch in the living room and bring them downstairs, setting Sana up with them before I leave.
lines.zh: 我从客厅的沙发上拿了一个备用的枕头和一床毯子，拿下来给 Sana 铺好，然后才离开。

lines.en: It was another interesting night at the bar, if not anything else.
lines.zh: 不管怎么说，今晚又是一个有意思的夜晚。

lines.en: Hopefully, this time I can find it within myself to not forget such an important detail about her life.
lines.zh: 希望这一次，我能让自己记住她生命中这么重要的一件事。

lines.en: But, for some reason, I already feel like something along those lines won’t happen again.
lines.zh: 可不知为什么，我已经有种预感——那样的事不会再发生了。

lines.en: It’s safe to say that Sana’s become pretty important to me.
lines.zh: 可以肯定的是，Sana 对我来说已经相当重要了。

lines.en: Sure, she might be more like a daughter than anything else at this moment, but-
lines.zh: 诚然，此刻她在我心里也许更像个女儿——

lines.en: But I’m sure that still has room to change...
lines.zh: 但我相信，这还有改变的空间……

lines.en: I mean, who knows?
lines.zh: 我是说，谁知道呢？

lines.en: This is Kumon-mi, after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟这里是 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: Anything can happen here.
lines.zh: 在这里，什么都有可能发生。
